info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API enables users to effectively manage their notification preferences by unsubscribing from weather alerts. This endpoint allows clients to remove their subscription from receiving critical weather updates, ensuring personalized communication. Typical consumers include users of weather applications who wish to customize their alert settings for a better experience. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user satisfaction and engagement through tailored notification management.

delete.description: This operation allows users to unsubscribe from specific alerts, effectively disabling notifications for those alerts. It ensures that users can manage their alert subscriptions according to their preferences.

requestBody.description: Request body for unsubscribing from alerts, which should contain the necessary identifiers to specify which alerts to unsubscribe from.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to unsubscribe from alerts. It is expected to be a string, typically used for passing a message or identifier.
